semiconductor_relevance: High — Arkema provides high-performance polymer solutions specifically engineered for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Arkema (China) Investment Co., Ltd. is a global leader in specialty materials, offering high-purity, high-performance polymer solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products, including Kynar® PVDF and Zenimid™ polyimides, are designed to meet the extreme chemical and thermal demands of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: High-purity piping systems for semiconductor fabrication
Wet benches and fluid handling components
Ultra-high-performance polyimide materials for demanding environments

regional_presence.China: Arkema operates 10 production sites and 2 R&D centers in China as part of its global industrial footprint.
